pattern_query.adopted: WNI korban penipuan lowongan kerja <destination as extracted, else luar negeri> · topic general · country indonesia · social-media domains excluded
pattern_query.definition: RELEVANT = an item (judge by its title, URL, and any verified quote from it) that EITHER (a) reports a case or pattern of Indonesians deceived by an overseas job offer into trafficking / online-scam work / illegal placement, matching THIS case's destination country (the offered or the actual one) OR its job type (e.g. "admin/marketing/customer service in Thailand/Cambodia/Myanmar", "ABK/bartender in Spain", "ferienjob in Germany"); OR (b) is an official warning (government ministry, KBRI/embassy, KP2MI/BP2MI, police, Kemnaker, Kemlu, Imigrasi) about deceptive overseas job offers in general. NOT relevant: generic job-scam tips about domestic fake vacancies (e.g. a bank's "ciri-ciri lowongan kerja palsu"), unrelated fraud (investment, VAT, visa scams in other countries' contexts), items about other countries' citizens, items whose title/quote gives no sign of the above. An Instagram/Facebook/YouTube item counts if its title or verified quote clearly meets (a) or (b); a bare "Instagram" title with no verified quote does not count.
